tool_mode: built-in image_gen source generation plus local chroma-key removal

style_lock.mascot: bright sky-blue fox-like Fuxie coach, teal hoodie/accessories, soft white face/chest, rounded 3D clay-like mobile-game style
rules: sky blue and teal lead the brand identity
amber is reserved for reward emphasis
assets must read at small UI sizes
cutout assets must pass alpha QA before runtime handoff
no external-game/IP resemblance, no Nintendo-like or Animal Crossing-like elements

assets.name: Mascot Reference
assets.ui_role: Canonical Fuxie style reference for future mascot poses
assets.prompt: Canonical full-body 3D Fuxie mascot reference for a German-learning mobile app: bright sky-blue fox-like learning coach, teal hoodie, soft white face/chest, large warm eyes, rounded clay-like mobile game style, centered full-body 3/4 front view on flat #ff00ff chroma-key background, no text, no watermark, original IP only.
assets.negative_prompt: Avoid realistic fur, orange fox dominance, beige/brown dominance, leaf motifs, external-game resemblance, Nintendo-like or Animal Crossing-like elements, clutter, background objects, cast shadows, contact shadows, reflections.
assets.alpha_requirement: transparent corners, alpha channel present, no residual chroma-key fringe in visible pixels

assets.name: Palette Tokens
assets.ui_role: Palette/material color reference for Fuxie Bright Sky production assets
assets.prompt: Six rounded 3D sample tokens for the Fuxie German Village palette: sky blue, deep blue, teal, soft sky-white, warm soft white, and a smaller amber reward accent token, arranged as a compact fan on flat #ff00ff chroma-key background, polished clay-like matte surfaces, no text or labels.
assets.negative_prompt: Avoid beige/brown dominance, dark palettes, heavy gradients, clutter, background objects, cast shadows, contact shadows, reflections, copied external-game UI/item shapes.
assets.alpha_requirement: transparent corners, alpha channel present, no residual chroma-key fringe in visible pixels

assets.name: Material Surface Test
assets.ui_role: Material and lighting reference for matte clay surfaces
assets.prompt: Compact material test cluster showing Fuxie German Village 3D surface language: sky-blue mascot-ear sample, teal hoodie patch, deep-blue beveled UI tile, soft-white face/chest bead, and small amber reward coin accent on flat #ff00ff background, smooth matte clay-like forms, no text.
assets.negative_prompt: Avoid realistic fur strands, fuzzy plush texture, fabric noise, wood grain dominance, beige/brown dominance, metallic glare, glass, reflections, cast shadows, contact shadows, background props, external-game resemblance.
assets.alpha_requirement: transparent corners, alpha channel present, no residual chroma-key fringe in visible pixels

assets.name: Edge Alpha Test
assets.ui_role: Alpha cleanup stress test for curves, holes, and small details
assets.prompt: Compact 3D cutout object designed to test chroma-key edge cleanup: sky-blue Fuxie-style tail curl, rounded ear sample, teal ribbon loop, white paw bead, and deep-blue path node as a single cluster with visible negative-space holes on flat #ff00ff background, matte clay-like style, no text.
assets.negative_prompt: Avoid realistic fur strands, hair, feathers, transparent glass, smoke, glow halos, cast shadows, contact shadows, reflections, background props, clutter, external-game resemblance.
assets.alpha_requirement: transparent corners, alpha channel present, no residual chroma-key fringe in visible pixels

assets.name: UI Frame Test
assets.ui_role: Production frame style test for quest cards, result panels, and notices
assets.prompt: Reusable 3D UI frame prop for Fuxie German Village: empty rounded village notice-board frame with sky-blue and teal beveled trim, soft-white inner panel, deep-blue corner pins, tiny amber reward accent dots, centered on flat #ff00ff background, no text.
assets.negative_prompt: Avoid decorative clutter, wooden-brown dominance, parchment fantasy look, heavy gradients, realistic material noise, cast shadows, contact shadows, reflections, copied external-game UI, Nintendo-like or Animal Crossing-like elements.
assets.alpha_requirement: transparent corners, alpha channel present, no residual chroma-key fringe in visible pixels

assets.name: Reward Icon Test
assets.ui_role: Reward economy style test for Fucoin, XP, badges, and earned states
assets.prompt: Original reward icon bundle for Fuxie German Village: amber coin with simple sparkle relief and sky-blue rim, two small XP stars, teal ribbon tab, and deep-blue badge backing, centered on flat #ff00ff background, celebratory but restrained, no text.
assets.negative_prompt: Avoid money symbols, gambling cues, loot box tropes, excessive sparkles, photoreal metal glare, cast shadows, contact shadows, reflections, background props, copied external-game item shapes, Nintendo-like or Animal Crossing-like elements.
assets.alpha_requirement: transparent corners, alpha channel present, no residual chroma-key fringe in visible pixels
